scenarios.prompt: Record an unedited completion take for a specific build and target. Assign capture ID, preserve source take, and attach state/debug provenance.

criteria.provenance: Capture ID links exact build/target/state provenance to source take references.
criteria.editing: Material cuts/retimes/overlays/audio changes are recorded in an edit manifest.
criteria.evidence: Artifact claim scope is explicit; promotional edits do not silently prove unedited gameplay.
